lines.text: The Reubenites and Gadites received land along the Arnon Valley, and Manasseh's half-tribe received the rest of Gilead and Bashan.
Jair, a descendant of Manasseh, renamed Bashan after himself, calling it Havvoth-jair.
The men of valor were to cross over armed ahead of their brothers, while families and livestock could stay.
Moses told Caleb not to be afraid of the kingdoms ahead, because the LORD Himself would fight for him.
Moses asked to cross over and see the good land, but the LORD sent him up Nebo to look.
